spec.description: ModelCacheEntry spec - desired state. One CR per cached model.

modelName.description: Full model name (e.g., `meta-llama/Llama-3.1-70B`). Preserved in spec so operators can recover the original name even when the CR's metadata.name is a sanitized/hashed form.

claimId.description: Opaque identity of the replica that currently owns a download.

createdAt.description: RFC3339 timestamp of first write. Omitted until the first status patch.

lastUsedAt.description: RFC3339 timestamp of most recent status write or touch.

leaseExpiresAt.description: Owner-generated RFC3339 heartbeat deadline. Observers use changes in this value to measure liveness locally instead of comparing clocks across replicas.

message.description: Optional human-readable message (download progress, error reason).

phase.description: One of `"Downloading"`, `"Downloaded"`, `"Error"`. Empty string on freshly-created records that haven't yet received a status patch.
